description: Altman backed Helion (chairman, led $500M round) and promoted its 2028 Microsoft power deal. Helion missed its own 2021 'net electricity by 2024' target and its 2025 Polaris net-electricity goal (unmet per Dec 2025 reporting; Polaris hit 150M°C D-T fusion in Feb 2026 but no net electricity). promise: Nvidia will raise over $500 billion in third-party capital for AI infrastructure through compute financing platforms with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR
description: On August 10, 2026, Nvidia signed memorandums of understanding with six major financial institutions - Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR - to launch compute financing platforms aimed at raising more than $500 billion in third-party capital for AI infrastructure. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said the company has the option to backstop up to $125 billion (25%) of the potential deals. No deployment timetable was disclosed; the end of 2028 is used as a review horizon.
evidence: MOUs with six firms announced August 10, 2026; Reuters and CNN coverage August 11-12
No timetable disclosed; Huang confirmed up to $125 billion Nvidia backstop option
